main_text.p: pòst habebitur: placuit Domino per prophetā aliquid & de ea prænūtiare. Prædicit itaq;, Aethiopes cōmunis periculi debere esse participes: & postquā multi eorū in bello fuerint trucidati, cæteros adhuc ab hoste Assy-rio miserè spoliādos ac diripiendos. At nihilominus Dominus pro sua bonitate seruaturū quasdā Aethiopū reliquias, ex quibus olim ad Ecclesiā Dei per prædicationē Euāgelij innumerabiles adducētur. Sic aūt orditur:

O' terra confidēs sub umbra.) Exordiū, quo aduocat et attētos esse iubet Aethiopes ad ea quæ dictu rus est. Describit uero eos, ad quos seu de quibus cōcionatur, longa periphrasi seu potius notatione, dum circumstantias, signa atq; actiones, e quibus Aethiopes ac finitimi quidam populi dignosci haud obscurè queat, annotat. Primo quidē uocat umbrā alarū. quæ appellatio iustissimè cōuenit Aethiopiæ, siue quia Meroe, quæ caput ac regia Aethiopiæ est, fluminibus alluitur sic sese effundētibus, ut alarū speciē repræsentent: siue quia in fretes in Aethiopia sunt portus et stationes, ad quas, tanquā umbrā, naues, quarū uela sunt instar alarū, se recipiūt. Ala aūte per metonymiā & synecdochen nō incō modè pro naui usurpatur. Siquidē uelis tanquā alis nae ues per mare agūtur. Vnde etiā in fabulis Poetarū, qui primus uela nauiū inuenit Dædalus, alas excogitasse et super aquas uolasse dicitur. Secūdò addit aliam notā de situ, dicēs: Quæ est trās uel secūdū flumina Aethiopiæ. Sanè si habitant ad flumina Aethiopiæ, non possumus alios

page.notes: Lower part of the last line is a catchword-like continuation; the final word "alios" is printed at the right of the last line. Several words are uncertain: "fretes" (the text reads "fretes" in the line "siue quia fretes"), and the phrase "Quæ est trās uel fecūdū" is read as printed. Marked [?] words were not flagged because the scan is clear enough, but the word "Dædalus" and the Greek-free text are otherwise legible. The line "O' terra confidēs" and the paragraph breaks are approximate for the lower half of the page. The page has no catchword or signature.
